title: Listen before looking
text: Pause for one quiet minute outside. Wildlife often announces itself before it comes into view.

title: Leave a little wild
text: Seed heads, leaf litter, and quiet corners can provide food and shelter for small backyard visitors.

title: Dawn has layers
text: The dawn chorus changes minute by minute. Try listening at the same place on several mornings.

title: Notice the regulars
text: Common visitors are worth knowing well. Their familiar calls make unusual arrivals easier to recognize.

title: Weather changes the soundscape
text: Wind, rain, temperature, and season all shape which voices carry through a habitat.
